api_checks.description: POST /auth/login → 200 — for each seeded CUSTOMER, UNDERWRITER and ADMIN; GET /auth/session then names exactly one role and that role's landing surface
GET /products → 200 — as CUSTOMER; at least one product and every entry carries a policy_version_id
POST /products/{product_code}/policy-versions → 201 — as ADMIN saving a new minimum-income threshold; the body carries a new policy_version_id
GET /products/{product_code} → 200 — in the same running process; cites the policy_version_id from QA-VM-014 with no restart
